notes: Paper (arXiv:2503.11753, Pinetti) presents first JWST constraints on QCD axion DM via axion decay to infrared photons, using MIRI (0.1-0.5 eV) and NIRSpec (0.5-4 eV) blank-sky observations. 95% CL limits on g_agamma shown in Fig. 2 spanning ~1e-13 to 1e-9 GeV^-1 axis; no numerical table of limit values is provided, so data_points are approximate values estimated from the figure description and the stated >2 orders of magnitude improvement over existing bounds (e.g. CAST ~6.6e-11 GeV^-1). Assumes axions are all of Milky Way DM with NFW profile (rs=24 kpc, rho_s=0.18 GeV/cm^3); this is an indirect-detection decay search, not a haloscope, so dm_density_assumed left null.
